name: watcher_status
description: Get watcher service health, version, and uptime.

name: watcher_service
description: Manage the watcher system service. Actions: install, uninstall, start, stop, restart, status.

name: watcher_config
description: Query watcher running configuration. Optional JSONPath filter.

name: watcher_config_apply
description: Apply a config patch to the running watcher service.

name: watcher_search
description: Semantic search over indexed documents. Supports Qdrant filters. This is a direct tool: call it directly, never through tool_call.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

name: watcher_enrich
description: Set or update metadata on a document by file path.

path.description: Relative file path of the document.

metadata.description: Key-value metadata to set on the document.

name: watcher_validate
description: Validate a candidate config (or current config if omitted). Optionally test file paths against the config to preview rule matching and metadata output.

config.description: Candidate config (partial or full). Omit to validate current config.

testPaths.description: File paths to test against the config for dry-run preview.

name: watcher_reindex
description: Trigger a reindex of the watched files.

scope.description: Reindex scope: "rules" (default) re-applies inference rules; "full" re-embeds everything; "issues" re-processes files with errors; "path" reindexes a specific file or directory (requires path parameter); "prune" deletes points for files no longer in watch scope.

path.description: Target file or directory path (required when scope is "path"). Accepts a single path or array of paths.

dryRun.description: When true, compute and return the blast area plan without executing. Returns counts by root showing impact.

name: watcher_scan
description: Filter-only point query without vector search. Returns metadata for points matching a Qdrant filter. Use for structural queries: file enumeration, staleness checks, delta computation. Use watcher_search for semantic/similarity queries. This is a direct tool: call it directly, never through tool_call.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from previous response for pagination.

countOnly.description: If true, return { count } instead of points.

name: watcher_issues
description: Get runtime processing failures. Shows the documents (file path or source reference) that failed processing and why.

name: watcher_walk
description: Walk watched filesystem paths with glob intersection. Returns matching file paths from all configured watch roots, applying watch.ignored and gitignore filtering.

globs.description: Glob patterns to intersect with watch paths (e.g., ["**/.meta/meta.json"]).

name: watcher_vcs_status
description: Get version tracking health: enabled state, tracked roots, remote status, last activity

name: watcher_vcs_history
description: Query change history by path or glob with optional date range

glob.description: Path or glob pattern to query history for.

since.description: Start date (ISO 8601 or git date string).

until.description: End date (ISO 8601 or git date string).

limit.description: Maximum number of history entries to return.

name: watcher_vcs_show
description: Retrieve file content at a specific version

name: watcher_vcs_diff
description: Show what changed between two versions, or between a version and current

glob.description: Path or glob pattern to diff.

commitEnd.description: End version identifier (defaults to current if omitted).

name: watcher_vcs_revert
description: Undo changes by restoring files to a specific version

glob.description: Path or glob pattern to revert.

existingOnly.description: When true, only revert files that currently exist (skip deleted files).

name: watcher_vcs_exclude
description: Exclude or re-include paths from version tracking

glob.description: Glob pattern to exclude or re-include.

root.description: Tracked root to target (defaults to auto-detect).

remove.description: When true, remove the exclusion rule (re-include the path).

name: watcher_vcs_check
description: Check whether a path is excluded from version tracking and why

path.description: File path to check exclusion status for.
